answer_1.quote: With the recent development in language models and their ability to generate text, many automatic measures have been introduced to evaluate the quality of this generated text, and some of these measures have been used in obfuscation techniques.
answer_1.outputs: obfuscated versions of input documents through paraphrasing, lexical substitution, or back-translation

answer_2.quote: Examples of these metrics are METEOR, BLEU, and ROUGE-L... Examples of such metrics are the Universal Sentence Encoder (USE) and BERTScore... we used BLEU, ROUGE-1, 2, and L, METEOR (Banerjee and Lavie, 2005), BERTScore, and QuestEval to evaluate content preservation.
